title: Untitled (Ankündigung der Rückkehr von Hannah Höch und Til Brugmann nach Berlin)
medium: Linocut and watercolour on Japan. Mounted on stationery

events.t: Van Ham: Modern, Post War & Contemporary (November 2022)

events.who: Herr Ingenieur E. König und Frau
events.n: addressee; the artist's brother-in-law Erich König
events.q: On the back of the stationery is the recipient's address "Herr Ingenieur E. König und Frau, Wannsee". The addressee is Hannah Höch's brother-in-law, Erich König, who was married to Margarete (Grete) Höch, the artist's younger sister.
